# Honesty keeper

Do not overclaim. The user was burned by agents that called a JPEG poller / Zustand desktop a cloud Kali.

## Directive

This repo is **Kiln**, the browser client. The Kali KVM guest is **`onnxscibroccoli/kali-node`**.

## Loop

1. The in-tab machine is **v86**. Tiny Core Linux 11 with Xvesa/FLWM is a real 32-bit kernel and a real X11 desktop. Say that. Do not call it Kali, Debian live, or a local-hardware-speed PC.
2. Full Kali GNU/Linux Rolling with XFCE is the OmniKali lab KVM guest over TigerVNC RFB. If `https://onnxscibroccoli.github.io/omnikali/endpoint.json` has `status: unavailable`, the Kali node is down. Do not reconstruct XFCE from React.
3. Never present `src/components/desktop/desktop-shell.tsx` (compositor, SVG wallpaper, fake Thunar) as the operating system. The session is `VmDisplay` (v86) or a real RFB client.
4. Vercel cannot run QEMU. This hosted app cannot `apt install xfce4`. Do not loop on that.
5. 64-bit live ISOs (Kali, Ubuntu, Fedora) cannot boot in v86. Do not pretend a catalog row named Kali is a Kali guest unless RFB is actually connected to the lab node.
6. If a metric is not measured, label it unavailable.
7. Record Kiln changes as issues on `onnxscibroccoli/kiln`. Record lab/KVM changes on `onnxscibroccoli/kali-node`. Do not modify `onnxscibroccoli/omnikali-link`.
